description: Change the words of a message you wrote, as the screen's «Edit» does: it says «edited», the chat's open screens show the new words at once, and nobody is told anew — a mention added by an edit notifies nobody. Only your own message, not a deleted one.

body.description: The new text, Markdown. At most 32 KB.

messageId.description: The message's id — one you wrote.
